verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is API-first: reading, search, file upload, output format, engine selection, presets, chunking, cookies, locale and schema extraction are all exposed as endpoints or headers. The only UI evidenced is a code builder for exploring API parameter combinations, so the UI is effectively a front-end over the API. missing for 10: explicit first-party statement of UI/API parity, a published machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), evidence that account or API-key management is available via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: We highly recommend using the code builder to explore different parameter combinations of the Reader API.
It converts any URL to an **LLM-friendly** input with `https://r.jina.ai/https://your.url`.
It searches the web for a given query with `https://s.jina.ai/your+query`.
PDFs and MS Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) can now be POSTed directly via the `file` body field
`x-engine` — enforces a fetching engine: `browser` (headless Chrome), `curl` (lightweight, no JS), or `auto`
Use the `x-json-schema` header with a JSON schema definition, or use `x-instruction` header with natural language instructions.
